messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Alert: auth-proxy eu-west-1 high-entropy request stream detected (spike 401/403). Sampled logs show tokens in debug lines. flow_id=abcd1234
omar: seeing it. confirming the spike on our dashboards. which customers impacted?
emily: pulling log snippets now. initial scrub looks like internal debug logging accidentally enabled in auth sidecar. could contain masked tokens but need full sweep.
lucy: CX reported elevated 401s for cust_id=red-corp and maybe two sandbox tenants. opening support ticket.
omar: i'm taking pager. will flip debug flag off and start a partial block by geo to reduce noise. handover to sec in 10m if needed.
emily: ready for rotation plan. propose: 1) disable debug logging on auth-sidecar 2) rotate short-lived signing key for proxy 3) run redact & scrub job on any forwarded logs 4) update customers.
raj: agree on comms. which customers first? red-corp affected most. label severity P2 for now until token exposure confirmed.
omar: executing disable now: ```kubectl -n auth rollout restart deploy/auth-sidecar && kubectl patch configmap auth-config -p '{"data": {"DEBUG": "false"}}'```
omar: disabled debug flag, traffic dropped ~40% in 2m.
emily: collecting log bundles. snippet (redacted): ```[2026-03-17T09:12:34Z] auth-sidecar DEBUG token=***abcd... user=alice@red-corp svc=proxy``` Looks like truncation but still PII risk.
lucy: support ticket #INC-6421 created. Customer liaison pinged red-corp CSM and asked for acknowledgement.
emily: starting key rotation: generating new signing key in KMS and scheduling 5-min overlap window. rotation command: ```kms-cli rotate --key alias/redwood/auth-proxy --grace-period 300s```
omar: applying temporary rate-limit for unknown origins and dropping suspicious IP ranges (eu-west-1 sample). Adding WAF rule now.
legal: looped in. recommend preserving original logs in secure vault for forensics and avoid broad customer comms until impact assessed.
emily: scrub job queued to redact tokens from forwarded logs, will record hashes for audit before deletion. command: ```log-scrub --pattern 'token=\S+' --replace 'token=[REDACTED]' --audit /secure/vault/incident-1765554321```
raj: draft customer note (internal) ready. would like product + support to OK before sending.
lucy: will coordinate with CSMs. red-corp notified in private channel; awaiting their reply.
omar: handing off pager to emily for the next 30m while I stabilize WAF and watchlist. emily, you're oncall.
emily: taking pager. I'll monitor key rotation and scrub progress, will escalate if evidence of exfiltration.
omar: logged incident ticket and initial timeline in #incidents-board. tagging SRE for follow-up.
emily: scrub completed for forwarded sinks; found 8 entries with partial tokens, scrubbed and saved audit hashes. no evidence of mass exfil.
emily: rotation completed at 09:28Z, old key revoked at 09:33Z. rolling restart of proxy clients started.
lucy: red-corp confirms degraded login attempts have normalized. they asked for post-mortem and mitigation steps.
emily: marking mitigation as successful for now. collecting remediation items: - remove debug flag from all sidecars via policy - add CI check to prevent debug env in prod - improve log-scrub automation - add emergency key-rotate playbook + templates
legal: please preserve chain-of-custody and all audit logs. we may need to notify regulator if PII confirmed.
omar: great work. i'll follow up in AM with full timeline. emily, stay on until proxy restarts finish.
emily: will. closing pager handoff note here. anyone add anything? :thumbsup:
lucy: adding customer comms draft to INC-6421, will attach PR when approved.
raj: schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC to review root cause and action items.
emily: agreed. updating incident severity to resolved-P2 pending postmortem.
pagerbot: Incident 1765554321 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.
